title: Photo: uniformed guards at the Damascus Gate, Jerusalem
summary: Dusk photograph of the Damascus Gate in Jerusalem, with a blue circle drawn around three uniformed security personnel standing guard in front of the gate.

pictures.description: Photo of the floodlit Damascus Gate at dusk under a deep blue sky, seen from across the road behind a metal fence; a car blurs past on the left. A blue circle highlights three men in dark green uniforms, one carrying a backpack, standing guard by the railings in front of the gate; civilians stand nearby.

keywords: possess the gate of their enemies
uncertain: The circled figures appear to be uniformed security forces (soldiers or police); the photo is not sharp enough to say which.
